body.justification: The construction is computable from observed raw moments, gives an explicit \(n^{-1/2}\) moment radius, and quantifies when projected uncertainty contracts or persists at a collision.
body.gap: General robust GMM does not specify this legal proxy-cumulant fiber, while the anchor conditions on selected polynomial roots.
body.consumer: CEId-from-Moments can return a valid set and an instability warning near collisions instead of an unreliable selected-root interval.
